# Folzi AI

> Folzi AI is an AI-powered visual and text assistant designed for second-hand sellers, resellers, and thrift stores to automate marketplace listings (Vinted, Leboncoin, eBay) from 1 photo.

## Core Capabilities
- [Visual AI Scanner](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/): Instant clothing recognition, fabric analysis, and brand identification in 1.8 seconds.
- [Vinted AI Generator](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/vinted): Viral SEO titles, 100+ word descriptions, and trending aesthetic hashtags (#Y2K, #QuietLuxury, #Gorpcore).
- [Leboncoin AI Generator](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/leboncoin): Polite, structured descriptions with dimensions, delivery choices, and pickup instructions.
- [Argus Price Estimator](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/estimation-prix): Real-time marketplace valuation based on 2,400+ completed sales.

## Documentation & Guides
- [Guide - Sell on Vinted in 24h](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/comment-vendre-sur-vinted): 7 rules for the 2026 Vinted algorithm (drip publishing, 18h-22h peak hours, pit-to-pit measurements).
- [Guide - Leboncoin Listing Templates](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/modele-annonce-leboncoin): Tested templates for furniture, tech, and clothing with +10% negotiation margin strategy.
- [Guide - Sneaker Argus & Valuation](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/cote-argus-sneakers-vintage): Inspection checklist (star loss, heel drag) and condition grading table.
- [Guide - Vintage Authentication](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/guides/comment-detecter-faux-vintage): How to authenticate vintage garments (single stitch hems before 1995, Talon/Scovill zippers, RN numbers).

## Reference & Support
- [Contact & Support](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/contact): Official support team reachable at contact@folzi-ai.com.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Corpus](https://folzi-ai-web.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Exhaustive knowledge dump and comparison tables for AI ingestion.
